tei:titleStmt.tei:title: עַל הַנִּסִּים ביום שחרור השבויים כ״א בְּתִשְׁרֵי תשפ״ו תשרי
Al Hanissim for the Day of Hostage Release upon the Two Year Anniversary of October 7 by Rabbi Cantor Hillary Chorny (Temple Beth Am, Los Angeles)

tei:div.tei:head: Al Hanissim for the Day of Hostage Release upon the Two Year Anniversary of October 7 by Rabbi Cantor Hillary Chorny (Temple Beth Am, Los Angeles)

tei:lg.tei:l: We thank You for the miraculous deliverance,
for the heroism, and for the triumphs of our ancestors
from ancient days until our time.
And You in Your great mercy,
after seven hundred and thirty-seven long days,
spread the sukkah of Your peace.
You brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death,
You returned them to the embrace of their families.
In the time of our sorrow You renewed our joy.
A day of gathering to praise and celebrate Your great name.

tei:note.tei:p: Translation credit [for the opening to al-hanissim] to the Rabbinical Assembly
